names: Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west)
Mission Bay Commons parcels P12, P13, P15
summary: The three westernmost parcels of Mission Bay Commons (P12, P13 and P15) host interim uses – Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens mini golf, Urban Sprouts community garden and soccer fields – which Rec and Park says were 'initially launched as interim uses'; a project fully funded through OCII will renovate them into a permanent park, with construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030 on Rec and Park's estimated schedule.

milestones.text: Spark Social SF, one of the interim uses on these parcels, launches at 601 Mission Bay Blvd. North (Parklab's project page: 'launch date: May 2016'). The page covers Spark Social only; the soccer fields, garden and mini golf are not dated in any source read
Rec and Park assumes management and maintenance of Mission Bay's park spaces

OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks update to its Citizens Advisory Committee names the Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17) among the parks being planned and shows a transfer to Rec and Park 'end of 2028, upon completion'
Rec and Park reports the Future Parks project moving into design: a request for qualifications 'was released in early August' and a design team 'should be selected by mid-October'
Construction of the permanent park expected to begin 'late 2028' (Rec and Park estimated schedule)
Permanent park expected to open to the public 'early 2030' (Rec and Park estimated schedule); the same page also says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028'

facts.value: P12, P13 and P15 (Rec and Park); OCII's November 2024 update lists them within 'Mission Bay Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17)'. Which interim use sits on which parcel is not stated in the sources read
Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens Mini Golf, Urban Sprouts Community Garden and SFF soccer fields (Rec and Park)
Design and construction of the permanent project 'fully funded through OCII' (Rec and Park); Rec and Park will own and operate the parks on completion
Planning 2024-2025, design mid 2026, construction begins late 2028, open to the public early 2030 (Rec and Park estimated schedule)

open_questions: SCHEDULE CONFLICT NOT RESOLVED: the geometry file's notes say Rec and Park's Workshop 3 deck (April 29, 2025) shows construction 'mid-2027 thru 2028'; that PDF returned no text layer here and was not read, so only the project page's 'late 2028' start is cited. The page's own text also says both 'anticipated to be complete by 2028' and 'Open to the Public, Early 2030'.

Opening dates of the soccer fields, community garden, Stagecoach Greens and Parklab Gardens were not found; only Spark Social's May 2016 launch is sourced, and the page does not say which parcel it is on.

The mapped polygon (an OpenStreetMap park strip named Parklab, per the geometry file) was not checked against the P12/P13/P15 parcel boundaries; the match is inferred, as the geometry file's own notes say.
The Rec and Park project page is undated and shows 'Project update, October 2026' alongside August 2025; the schedule on it may be revised.
The OCII November 2024 deck's own schedule graphic is an image; only its text was read.
